glosses: Obsolete spelling of mitteilen which was deprecated in 1902 following the Second Orthographic Conference of 1901.

examples.text: […] so müßte diese Entwickelung irgend einmal in einem Individuum beginnen, und dieser Eine müßte dann eben frei un offen mittheilen, daß die Andern zu einem bisher ihnen unbekannten Zustande sich entwickeln sollen; […]
examples.translation: […] thus this evolution had to start one time in one individual, and this one then must inform freely and openly that the others should evolve themselves to an as yet unknown state; […]
examples.english: […] thus this evolution had to start one time in one individual, and this one then must inform freely and openly that the others should evolve themselves to an as yet unknown state; […]
